changes: Installed-candidate reconciliation now binds exact candidate SHA and rollback SHA while permitting a distinct current continuation authorization ID; pre-install path still requires the install authorization ID.
Smoke-only runner no longer performs automatic R4 recovery; critical device-health failure records recovery authorization required and stops.
Smoke-only authorization requires recovery limit 0; firmware install remains prohibited.
failure_classification: Genuine provisional-release path defect: identity exception bound installed R6 to the consumed install authorization ID; a fresh smoke-continuation authorization necessarily has a different ID. Historical R7 Packet20 adapter remains correctly pinned and unchanged.
